theorem OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.actual_minor_analytic_bound {nu : ℝ} (d : FixedData nu) (hnu : 0 ≤ nu)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (selection : Row d H → Column d H)
    (hne : (actualMinor d H selection).det ≠ 0) :
    Real.log ‖(actualMinor d H selection).det‖ / ((actualRowCount d H : ℝ) * H) ≤
      d.analyticError + analyticRemainder d H +
        max (-collisionRate d H)
          (-nu * ((d.base.A : ℝ) * (1 - d.base.eta) - actualMean d H)) := by
  sorry
matches.natural_language_statement: For the original fixed datum $d$, $\nu\ge0$, height $H>0$, and a column selection with nonzero selected-minor determinant, the normalized logarithmic determinant is at most $d.analyticError+R_d(H)+\max\{-collisionRate_d(H),-\nu((d.A)(1-d.eta)-actualMean_d(H))\}$, with every term and binder exactly as in the source theorem.
